As the world raced to rescue the trapped miners in a disaster that made international headlines, two psychologists were tasked with maintaining everyone's mental health. Chilean Minister of Mines Laurence Golborne holds a note from the miners while President Sebastián Piñera gives a speech during rescue operations. Miguel Soffia By Angela Posada-Swafford Published September 25, 2026 For Alex Vega, the morning of August 5, 2010 started off just like any other. He headed towards the San José mine in Chile’s Atacama region, then descended 2,100 feet into the ground to start his work. Suddenly, after four hours on the job, he and the other men working alongside him heard several high-pitched, whistling noises. Key takeaways Data analysts use their knowledge of data to guide decision making within organizations. Four career paths data analysts can pursue are data scientist, a role in management, a specialist, and a consultant. At a glance, here's what you need to know about data analyst career paths: While working as a data scientist, you can earn a median total pay of $156,000 [ 1 ]. Three data analyst roles are business analyst, financial analyst, and operations analyst. You can work as a market research analyst in the field of data analysis. Below, you'll explore a variety of exciting data analyst career paths in the areas of data science, management, consulting, and more. If you're ready to jump in right away, consider enrolling in the Meta Data Analyst Professional Certificate . Execution model | Theme Auto Light Dark | 4. Execution model ¶ 4.1. Structure of a program ¶ A Python program is constructed from code blocks. A block is a piece of Python program text that is executed as a unit. The following are blocks: a module, a function body, and a class definition. Each command typed interactively is a block. A script file (a file given as standard input to the interpreter or specified as a command line argument to the interpreter) is a code block. A script command (a command specified on the interpreter command line with the -c option) is a code block. A module run as a top level script (as module __main__ ) from the command line using a -m argument is also a code block. The string argument passed to the built-in functions eval() and exec() is a code block. A code block is executed in an execution frame . More Control Flow Tools ¶ As well as the while statement just introduced, Python uses a few more that we will encounter in this chapter. 4.1. if Statements ¶ Perhaps the most well-known statement type is the if statement. For example: >>> x = int ( input ( "Please enter an integer: " )) Please enter an integer: 42 >>> if x < 0 : ... x = 0 ... print ( 'Negative changed to zero' ) ... elif x == 0 : ... print ( 'Zero' ) ... elif x == 1 : ... print ( 'Single' ) ... else : ... print ( 'More' ) ... More There can be zero or more elif parts, and the else part is optional. The keyword ‘ elif ’ is short for ‘else if’, and is useful to avoid excessive indentation. An if … elif … elif … sequence is a substitute for the switch or case statements found in other languages. If you’re comparing the same value to several constants, or checking for specific types or attributes, you may also find the match statement useful. For more details see match Statements . 4.2. for Statements ¶ The for statement in Python differs a bit from what you may be used to in C or Pascal. Rather than always iterating over an arithmetic progression of numbers (like in Pascal), or giving the user the ability to define both the iteration step and halting condition (as C), Python’s for statement iterates over the items of any sequence (a list or a string), in the order that they appear in the sequence.

The standard uncertainty of the applied forces incorporates the uncertainties associated with the determination of the mass of the deadweight, the acceleration due to gravity and the air density. The relative standard uncertainty of applied force is 0.0005 %. Deadweight machines are used to calibrate force measurement devices (typically load cells), equipment that then are used to measure things like the thrust of a rocket engine or the weight of an aircraft for example. The 4.45 MN machine is not only the largest at NIST but actually is the largest deadweight machine in the world meaning much of the world depends on our machine for SI traceable large force measurements. pages.text: 400 Home Run Club Skip to Content While the 500-homer club boasts sluggers such as Ted Williams, Mickey Mantle and Ernie Banks, the 400-homer club offers us a glimpse into one of baseball's superglues: a diversity of skills. The 400-homer club features athletic stars like the 5-foot-9 Mel Ott and the switch-hitting Chipper Jones. It includes players who fell just short of becoming elite sluggers, sometimes because they spent a considerable portion of their careers playing their home games in large ballparks. But it also features superstars -- Carl Yastrzemski, Carlos Beltrán and Cal Ripken Jr. -- who ended up right where we guessed they would. • Photos: 400-homer club Here are the members of the impressive 400-homer club: 59 players who blazed paths in their own unique ways, from the most recent to join to the first. Mike Trout , OF (2011-present) Career HR total: 404 Hit 400th on: Sept. 20, 2025 Injuries slowed Trout's path to 400 home runs, but the longtime Angels superstar reached the milestone with a titanic blast at Coors Field: 114.9 mph and 485 feet. Trout averaged 35 home runs over in his first eight full seasons, making the American League All-Star team each year. He passed Tim Salmon for the Angels' all-time home run lead with No. 300 back in 2020, but it took him another five years to get to No. 400. The seminar covers a broad range of topics in precision time and frequency measurement and applications, including about 25 talks from world-leading scientists and metrologists and several hands-on laboratory sessions. Precision timing is crucial to numerous technologies such as communications, GPS and other location/navigation services, high speed electronics, radar and surveillance, defense applications, electronic financial transactions, and many others. Leading high technology companies such as Lockheed Martin, Boeing, the Aerospace Corporation, and Microsemi sent scientists and managers to the seminar to learn how to improve their products and services using current technologies, and to learn about new NIST technologies relevant to future products and services.
